title: Tomba Phone Finder Actor Input
description: Input schema for the Tomba Phone Finder Actor that discovers phone numbers using the Tomba API.

searches.title: Search Queries
searches.description: Array of search queries to find phone numbers. Each query can contain email, domain, or LinkedIn profile.

email.title: Email Address
email.description: Email address to find phone number for

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Domain to search for phone numbers

linkedin.title: LinkedIn Profile
linkedin.description: LinkedIn profile URL to find phone number for

maxResults.title: Maximum Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of phone numbers to find. Default is 50.

full.title: Full phone record
full.description: Ask Tomba for the full phone record it has stored for each search (sent as `full=true`). Applies to every search and does not change the price.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Optional URL that Tomba also sends each result to (sent as `webhook_url` on every search). Must start with http:// or https://.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many Tomba requests run in parallel. There is no rate limit, so raise it for large lists.
maxConcurrency.sectionDescription: Concurrency, retry and cache settings. The defaults work well for most runs.

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry a request after a network error, 429 or 5xx response (exponential backoff). Failed requests are never charged.

useCache.title: Use cache
useCache.description: Reuse results from previous runs for identical requests. Cached results are free.

cacheTtlHours.title: Cache TTL (hours)
cacheTtlHours.description: How long cached results stay valid. 0 disables the cross-run cache.
